speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to evaluate your systemic hypertension. To begin, how old are you, and have you noticed any symptoms like headaches, vision changes, or palpitations?

speaker: Patient
text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery, is currently up to date on all vaccines, and is meeting all developmental milestones. His mother reports that he has been generally doing well with no concerns. No family history of cardiovascular disease. The boy does not take any medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Hypertension (Secondary workup required for 5-year-old). Since this is a well-child visit with no family history and the child is asymptomatic, we must rule out renal parenchymal disease or obstructive uropathy. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Electrolytes, BUN/Creatinine, and Renal Ultrasound.
